lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Birdie,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I wanted to find a human to ask a question.
What is it?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I was watching Ark Rangers on TV,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: and while it's totally unrealistic,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: there were some things that I could take away from it.
Like not breaking windows every time you make an entrance?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Shattering a window is imperative

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: if you want to make a flashy entrance.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: That's why people have installed so many of them everywhere.
... Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Anyway, back to what I wanted to ask you.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: The Ark Rangers all came in different colors:

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Red is the leader, Blue is the cool and collected one,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Black is the strongest physically, Yellow is the easiest on the eyes, and Pink is the youngest.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I think distinguishing by color like this

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: is a pretty solid idea.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: So, my question is:

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: What do you think my color would be?
Red, naturally.
I'm hoping you can calm down a bit, so blue.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Very interesting,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: but I'm afraid you're wrong.
Why?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Because

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I am a hero who possesses traits from all the colors.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Calm, strong, never settling for less, cute as a button, and a born leader.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: You see? I'm all the colors!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Haha!
But if you were to combine all the colors, you'd end up with black. So does that make your color black?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: is that how it works?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Then I guess from now on, I'm Laplace, the black hero!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Out!
